`demo/agent/` holds {{agent.n_cases}} real tool-calling trajectories copied from the sibling repo-engineer project (written by its scripted planner, not a model) and one synthetic variant of each with a single planted defect. Trajectory metrics compare the calls with a reference tool sequence and validate every argument against the tool's JSON Schema. Gating the variants against the originals gives "{{cmp.agent.summary.verdict}}": `tool_selection_accuracy` {{cmp.agent.tool_selection_accuracy.baseline|.4f}} to {{cmp.agent.tool_selection_accuracy.candidate|.4f}}, `tool_call_precision` {{cmp.agent.tool_call_precision.baseline|.4f}} to {{cmp.agent.tool_call_precision.candidate|.4f}}, `tool_args_schema_valid` {{cmp.agent.tool_args_schema_valid.baseline|.4f}} to {{cmp.agent.tool_args_schema_valid.candidate|.4f}} and `success_rate` {{cmp.agent.success_rate.baseline|.4f}} to {{cmp.agent.success_rate.candidate|.4f}}. With {{agent.n_cases|word}} paired cases the gate applies the plain tolerance rule; a paired test needs at least ten.
